correctness.rationale: A Cayley/Laplace/log unitary equivalence yields A_t h(x)=[t(1-t)]^-1/2 exp(-e^x/t)h(x+log((1-t)/t)). Weak-null interval plane-wave packets prove every Fourier-Stieltjes point is left essential approximate. Dominated convergence uses the exact finite critical moment and Fredholm left parametrices exclude such points from Fredholm resolvent. Weighted Fourier uniqueness and the adjoint reflection establish the iff reality dichotomy. Operator and power norms and strict norm nonattainment follow by the same model. The finite checker is only auxiliary.

value.rationale: A complete intrinsic criterion for whether the Fredholm essential spectrum is wholly real, valid for arbitrary atomic, singular or continuous nonzero positive measures satisfying the sharp boundedness moment, goes materially beyond known norm/noncompactness. It finds complex essential spectral points without computing full spectra, and supplies a reproducible Fourier curve useful for further spectral questions. Supporting essential-norm facts are not mistaken for the novel contribution.
